name: eap-studio-read-backend
description: Always-on ECS/Fargate backend serving the Console Build workspace read-only routes (deployed agents, deployment status, pattern resolve, latest deployment, gateway proxy, agent card, config). Replaces the studio-read Lambda + HTTP API Gateway path with a self-JWT-validating ALB backend (parity with the ADE invoke backend, ADR-040 pattern). For consistency: all console backends now run on ALB/Fargate.
author: Vikrant Dhir <vikdhir@amazon.com>
